Paris is unbelievable.
Chanel show so chic. So dramatic. So French.
50 models came out for the finale in the dark with little lights on the tips of the toes of their shoes...very cool.

I met Princess Beatrice today at Fizzy Barclay's London lunch and told her I slipped the dvd of "The King's Speech" to her
dad at your place...she loved it.

Where are you?
